hooks.logic:
Let aiArg be the battle settings of the group of the enemy.
Count up "turnForAppear".
Run helper2.
Let currentParamSuffixNo be the current form of the enemy.
Let v be the first x in list2 where currentParamSuffixNo is x's 'paramSuffixNo'.
If condition flag "ability_done" is up this frame, then set the register's 'isRecoverCrouch' to false.
If v's 'TurnForChangeAppearBreakSite' and the numeric entry v's 'TurnForChangeAppearBreakSite' in aiArg is less than the count "turnForAppear", then
  Reset the count "turnForAppear".
  Choose state 15 next and stop.
Run helper.
If the enemy is ready to act, then
  If the register's 'isRecoverCrouch' and the numeric entry v's 'TurnCountToUseCounterattackInPhase' in aiArg is at most the count "turnForAppear", then the enemy uses the id of the move labelled "recover_counter" on the enemy.
  Otherwise, the enemy picks and uses a smart-weighted move.

hooks.logic:
Let aiArg be the battle settings of the group of the enemy.
Count up "turnForDisAppear".
Run helper2.
If list2 at (the register's 'currBpIdx')'s 'TurnForChangeDisappearBreakSite' and the numeric entry list2 at (the register's 'currBpIdx')'s 'TurnForChangeDisappearBreakSite' in aiArg is less than the count "turnForDisAppear", then
  Reset the count "turnForDisAppear".
  Choose state 16 next and stop.
Let resultObjectsInFrame be the results "gilgamesh_damage" this frame.
If the length of resultObjectsInFrame is more than 0, then add call helper4 with (resultObjectsInFrame) to the register's 'totalDamage'.
Let number be the numeric entry list2 at (the register's 'currBpIdx')'s 'TotalDamageForCrouchBreakSite' in aiArg.
If the register's 'totalDamage' is at least number, then
  Set the register's 'totalDamage' to 0.
  Set the register's 'isRecoverCrouch' to true.
  Choose state 17 next and stop.
If the current form of the enemy is not list2 at (the register's 'currBpIdx')'s 'paramSuffixNoBreakSite', then
  The enemy changes to form list2 at (the register's 'currBpIdx')'s 'paramSuffixNoBreakSite'.
  The enemy cancels its cast.
If the enemy is ready to act, then the enemy picks and uses a smart-weighted move.
